cn_steps: 启用 `Led Wall Calibration`（运行时 `LedWallCalibration`，编辑器 `LedWallCalibrationEditor`），属 Virtual Production。
在 LED 墙虚拟制片场景里，用该工具对摄像机与 LED 墙做几何/色彩校准。
按引导采集校准数据，生成校正参数并应用到 nDisplay 配置。
这是校准工具；具体播放仍由 nDisplay / ICVFX 负责。
en_steps: Enable `Led Wall Calibration` (runtime `LedWallCalibration`, editor `LedWallCalibrationEditor`), part of Virtual Production.
In an LED-wall virtual production scene, use it to calibrate camera and LED wall geometry/color.
Follow the guided capture to collect calibration data, generate correction parameters, and apply them to the nDisplay config.
It is a calibration tool; actual playback stays with nDisplay / ICVFX.
note_cn: LED 墙几何/色彩校准，配合 nDisplay 与 ICVFX。
note_en: LED wall geometry/color calibration, paired with nDisplay and ICVFX.

cn_steps: 启用 `Legacy - Linear Timecode Reader`（模块 `LinearTimecode`）。
用它将线性时间码（LTC）从媒体源读成组件/时间码值，用于同步。
注意它不使用同步机制，只做读取；需要严格同步时要自行加上下游同步逻辑。
属 Media Framework；旧版命名，功能仍可用。
en_steps: Enable `Legacy - Linear Timecode Reader` (module `LinearTimecode`).
Use it to read linear timecode (LTC) from a media source into a component/timecode value for sync.
Note it does not apply a synchronization mechanism, only reads; add downstream sync yourself for strict sync.
Part of Media Framework; legacy naming but still functional.
note_cn: 读取线性时间码的组件，本身不做同步。
note_en: A component that reads linear timecode; it does not sync by itself.

cn_steps: `Legacy Composure` 是不再开发的遗留实时合成系统，新项目用 Composure（`CompositeCore`）方向的版本。
已有工程若仍依赖旧 Composure，按引擎提示迁移到新合成管线。
运行时依赖 `Composure`，编辑器模块 `ComposureEditor` / `ComposureLayersEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
迁移后尽量禁用本遗留插件，避免新旧合成并存。
en_steps: `Legacy Composure` is the no-longer-developed legacy real-time compositing system; new projects use the Composure (`CompositeCore`) path.
Existing projects still on old Composure should migrate to the new compositing pipeline as prompted.
Runtime depends on `Composure`; editor modules `ComposureEditor` / `ComposureLayersEditor` go to Editor targets only.
After migration, prefer disabling this legacy plugin so old and new compositing don't coexist.
note_cn: 遗留实时合成系统，不再开发，迁移到新 Composure。
note_en: The legacy real-time compositing system, no longer developed; migrate to the new Composure.

cn_steps: 启用 `Lens Component`（运行时 `LensComponent`，编辑器 `LensComponentEditor`），属 Virtual Production。
把 Lens Component 加到电影摄影机上，用它给相机画面添加镜头失真（与 Camera Calibration 配合）。
设置失真参数/镜头文件，实时预览并合成。
Game 模块依赖 `LensComponent`；`LensComponentEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Lens Component` (runtime `LensComponent`, editor `LensComponentEditor`), part of Virtual Production.
Add the Lens Component to a cinematic camera to apply lens distortion to its image (paired with Camera Calibration).
Set distortion parameters/lens files and preview/composite in real time.
Game modules depend on `LensComponent`; `LensComponentEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 给电影摄影机加镜头失真的组件，替代旧的镜头失真插件。
note_en: A component that adds lens distortion to cinematic cameras, replacing the legacy lens-distortion plugin.

cn_steps: `Lens Distortion (Deprecated)` 已被弃用，将在未来引擎版本删除。
迁移到 `CameraCalibration` 插件的功能，以及 `Lens Component` 的失真处理。
不要在 `Build.cs` 新增对该过时模块的依赖。
迁移完成后禁用本插件。
en_steps: `Lens Distortion (Deprecated)` is deprecated and will be removed in a future engine version.
Migrate to the `CameraCalibration` plugin's features and `Lens Component` for distortion.
Do not add new `Build.cs` dependencies on this deprecated module.
Disable this plugin after migration.
note_cn: 已弃用，改用 CameraCalibration + Lens Component。
note_en: Deprecated; use CameraCalibration + Lens Component instead.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Level Sequence Editor`（模块 `LevelSequenceEditor`）并重启。
双击 LevelSequence 资产，在序列编辑器里编排过场/镜头/事件。
加轨道、打关键帧、绑定 Actor 与摄像机，用于过场动画与影视制作。
这是编辑器模块，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Level Sequence Editor` (module `LevelSequenceEditor`) and restart.
Double-click a LevelSequence asset to author cutscenes/shot/events in the sequence editor.
Add tracks, keyframe, and bind actors and cameras for cinematic sequences.
It is editor-only; Editor targets only, does not ship.
note_cn: LevelSequence 资产的编辑器，用于过场编排，纯编辑器。
note_en: The editor for LevelSequence assets used for cinematic authoring, editor-only.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Level Sequence Navigator Bridge`（模块 `LevelSequenceNavigatorBridge`）。
为关卡序列提供序列导航桥，配合 Sequencer 的导航器在镜头/序列间跳转。
在编辑 Sequencer 时使用导航桥定位到具体序列段。
Experimental：接口可能变动；属序列编辑辅助，编辑器向。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Level Sequence Navigator Bridge` (module `LevelSequenceNavigatorBridge`).
It provides a sequence navigator bridge for Level Sequences, pairing with the Sequencer navigator to jump between shots/sequences.
Use the navigator bridge while editing Sequencer to locate specific sequence segments.
Experimental: contract may change; it is sequence-editing assist, editor-oriented.
note_cn: 关卡序列的序列导航桥，Sequencer 辅助，实验性。
note_en: A sequence navigator bridge for Level Sequences, a Sequencer aid, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Level Streaming Persistence`（模块 `LevelStreamingPersistence`）。
用它持久化世界状态：Actor/子对象属性、被破坏状态、Actor 重生。
状态与流送关卡关联（可选与持久关卡关联），卸载/重载后恢复。
Experimental：接口可能变动；面向开放世界的大世界状态持久化。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Level Streaming Persistence` (module `LevelStreamingPersistence`).
Use it to persist world state: actor/subobject properties, destroyed states, and actor respawning.
State is associated with streaming levels (optionally with persistent levels) and restored after unload/reload.
Experimental: contract may change; aimed at large-world state persistence.
note_cn: 随流送关卡持久化世界状态（属性/破坏/重生），开放世界用。
note_en: Persists world state (properties/destruction/respawn) with streaming levels, for open worlds.

cn_steps: 启用 `LevelSnapshots`（模块 `LevelSnapshots`、`LevelSnapshotFilters`、`LevelSnapshotsEditor`、`FoliageSupport`、`nDisplaySupport`），属 Virtual Production。
在编辑器里对关卡拍快照，之后可对比/回滚到指定快照。
用过滤器选择要快照/恢复的 Actor，支持植被与 nDisplay。
这是编辑器工作流工具；快照用于版本对比与恢复。
en_steps: Enable `LevelSnapshots` (modules `LevelSnapshots`, `LevelSnapshotFilters`, `LevelSnapshotsEditor`, `FoliageSupport`, `nDisplaySupport`), part of Virtual Production.
Take level snapshots in the editor, then compare or roll back to a chosen snapshot.
Use filters to choose which actors to snapshot/restore; foliage and nDisplay are supported.
It is an editor workflow tool; snapshots are for version comparison and recovery.
note_cn: 关卡快照与回滚（含植被/nDisplay），编辑器工作流工具。
note_en: Level snapshots and rollback (incl. foliage/nDisplay), an editor workflow tool.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `LibVpxCodecs`（模块 `LibVpxCodecs`）。
它把 LibVpx 的编解码器（VP8/VP9）加入 AVCodecs，供 AVEncoder 等使用。
在录制/解码流程里选择 VP8/VP9 编码，核对平台是否支持。
Experimental：接口可能变动；属编解码扩展。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `LibVpxCodecs` (module `LibVpxCodecs`).
It adds LibVpx codecs (VP8/VP9) to AVCodecs for use by AVEncoder and others.
Choose VP8/VP9 encoding in recording/decoding flows and confirm platform support.
Experimental: contract may change; it is a codec extension.
note_cn: 把 LibVpx（VP8/VP9）编解码加入 AVCodecs，实验性。
note_en: Adds LibVpx (VP8/VP9) codecs to AVCodecs, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 `LiDAR Point Cloud Support`（运行时 `LidarPointCloudRuntime`，编辑器 `LidarPointCloudEditor`）。
导入 LiDAR 点云数据（.las/.laz 等），在编辑器里处理、裁剪、着色。
把点云挂到 Actor 上渲染，用于测绘、场景参考或大世界重建。
Game 模块依赖 `LidarPointCloudRuntime`；`LidarPointCloudEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `LiDAR Point Cloud Support` (runtime `LidarPointCloudRuntime`, editor `LidarPointCloudEditor`).
Import LiDAR point-cloud data (.las/.laz, etc.) and process/crop/color it in the editor.
Attach the cloud to an actor for rendering, for surveying, scene reference, or large-world reconstruction.
Game modules depend on `LidarPointCloudRuntime`; `LidarPointCloudEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: LiDAR 点云的导入、处理与渲染，测绘/大世界参考用。
note_en: LiDAR point-cloud import, processing, and rendering for surveying/large-world reference.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Light Mixer`（模块 `LightMixer`）并重启。
用它的电子表格视图批量编辑场景灯光的任意属性（强度、颜色、温度等）。
适合灯光调试/布光对拍，快速对比多盏灯。
这是编辑器工具，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Light Mixer` (module `LightMixer`) and restart.
Use its spreadsheet view to batch-edit any scene light properties (intensity, color, temperature, etc.).
Great for lighting debugging/comparison across multiple lights.
It is an editor tool for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: 用电子表格批量编辑场景灯光属性，纯编辑器。
note_en: Batch-edit scene light properties in a spreadsheet, editor-only.

cn_steps: `LightWeightInstancesEditor` 已弃用（Deprecated）。
改用 `InstancedActors` 实现类似的大规模实例 Actor 功能。
不要在 `Build.cs` 新增对该过时模块的依赖。
迁移完成后禁用本插件。
en_steps: `LightWeightInstancesEditor` is deprecated.
Use `InstancedActors` for similar large-scale instanced-actor functionality.
Do not add new `Build.cs` dependencies on this deprecated module.
Disable this plugin after migration.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Linux Compiler-only Integration`（模块 `NullSourceCodeAccess`）并重启。
它在 Linux 上只查找 clang++、不绑定具体 IDE，用于仅编译的源码访问场景。
在 `Project Settings > Source Code Access` 里选择它，用外部命令/脚本编译。
这是编辑器开发者工具，只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Linux Compiler-only Integration` (module `NullSourceCodeAccess`) and restart.
On Linux it only looks for clang++ and binds no IDE, for compile-only source access.
Pick it in `Project Settings > Source Code Access` and build via external commands/scripts.
It is an editor developer tool for Editor targets only.
note_cn: Linux 上只找 clang++ 的源码访问集成，无 IDE 绑定。
note_en: A compile-only source-access integration on Linux that only looks for clang++, no IDE binding.

cn_steps: 启用 `Linux Device Profile Selector`（模块 `LinuxDeviceProfileSelector`）。
它根据 Linux 硬件选择对应的 Device Profile，运行时自动匹配。
在 `DeviceProfiles` 配置里为不同 Linux 硬件设置规则与画质参数。
这是平台设备配置选择器，部署到 Linux 时生效。
en_steps: Enable `Linux Device Profile Selector` (module `LinuxDeviceProfileSelector`).
It selects the matching Device Profile based on Linux hardware at runtime.
In `DeviceProfiles` config, set rules and quality settings for different Linux hardware.
It is a platform device-profile selector that takes effect when deploying to Linux.
note_cn: 按 Linux 硬件自动选 Device Profile。
note_en: Auto-selects Device Profiles by Linux hardware.
